title: client_config.rules
description: Effective profile rules of the device, resolved by the hub (catalog default -> profile -> device adjustment, possibly temporary -> boundaries guest access and parental controls -> prerequisites). Only rules that apply to the device's platform (and kids rules only with parental controls) are present; a missing rule keeps the app's own behavior. Clients ignore unknown rules and unknown source/reason values. GENERATED by tools/profile_rules.py from profile-rule-values.json - do not edit.

remote_access.description: Remote access: effective value with its source (generated by tools/profile_rules.py).

locked.description: true = the person at the device must not change the value (everything except user_choice).

fixed.description: true = the admin cannot adjust the rule on this device (profile checkbox “Fixed”, or decided by a boundary). Display only.

user_choice.description: true = the person at the device decides; value is the starting value and replaces nothing the person chose locally. Missing = false.

expires_at.description: Temporary device adjustment: end (UTC). The app switches to then at this time even offline; the hub sends client_config_updated.
